title: TEN PREMIER LEAGUE GAMES, ONE START: ESTEVAO IS STILL WAITING AT CHELSEA
description:
Estevao's only Premier League start so far came in a 2-0 win over Manchester United.

That is one start in ten league games. He is struggling for minutes under Xabi Alonso at Chelsea, though the record in that one start is perfect.

The reason, according to ESPN: Alonso likes a three-four-three, and it is a poor fit for him. Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers occupy the spots he likes.

Then look at Brazil. Ancelotti has started him in four of their five games since the World Cup. At Chelsea it is one from ten.

Alonso says there are no plans to move him on. Now he needs the minutes.

So what should happen? Should Alonso change the system for Estevao, or should Estevao wait his turn? Drop your answer below.
